name: WindowEye
source:
The world is weirder than it usually is and there's a hugeeee eyeball behind your window. Wyd?

[From [url=https://foxpearlwilder.itch.io/windoweye]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
外面的世界变得比平时还要诡异离谱，而且你的窗户外面正贴着一颗大——得吓人的眼球。你打算怎么办？

[摘自[url=https://foxpearlwilder.itch.io/windoweye]Itch.io[/url]]
